refused.item: anticipation cell-glow x4 (240x240), tall-reel-glow x4 (240x480), side-spark-streak 4f (64x240)
refused.reason: ORPHAN GLOWS: THERE IS NO ELEMENT TO PLAY THEM IN. The anticipation system is real and rich - escalation levels, a .col-focus tremble, non-focused reel dimming via a brightness filter, and a per-cell .scatter-charge bloom plus scanline - but it is implemented entirely in CSS. Verified: ZERO url() references in any anticipation rule, and GameGrid has no <canvas> and zero drawImage calls. Today's cell glow is a `filter:` on .tile-inner, not an overlay element. Attaching a raster glow means new markup per reel and per cell plus new state wiring to the escalation levels, which is not the 'tiny safe hook already exists' the brief allows.

THE ONE REAL RASTER SLOT IS A SINGLE STATIC IMAGE AT 22x22. GameGrid.svelte:1222-1223 renders two per column from ui/particles/spark.png, animated by a CSS rise/scale/fade. It is a genuine consumer with a genuine trigger (.col-focus), but it takes ONE still image, not a four-frame strip - a flipbook needs a packed sheet and steps() markup that does not exist. And it renders at 22x22, so a 128px source is 5.8x oversampled and nothing of the extra resolution can be seen. Its file is also owner WIP.

refused.item: symbol-life: land-impact-flash, win-cell-crown-glow, scatter-tease-ring, selected-cell-pulse (16 files, 240x240)
refused.reason: NO RASTER SLOT, AND ONE OF THEM HAS NO CONSUMER THAT COULD EVER EXIST. The cell is 120x100 (CELL_W 120, CELL_H 100, 5 reels x 4 rows, GameGrid.svelte:62-68) and the candidates are 240x240 SQUARE. Every existing symbol effect is CSS with zero url(): .scatter-charge is a linear-gradient scanline plus a 6x6 dot and a bloom animation (GameGrid.svelte:1663-1678), triggered per cell at :877. Taking these would mean replacing tuned CSS effects with rasters plus new four-frame flipbook markup. SEPARATELY, 'selected-cell-pulse' has no consumer BY DEFINITION: this is a slot machine and there is no cell-selection mechanic to pulse.
refused.quality_note: the art is genuinely good and on-palette. Centre openness, which the vendor claims for all four, holds for three: mean alpha in the central 50% box is 0.00-0.84 for land-impact, 0.04-0.49 for scatter-tease and 0.00 for selected-cell-pulse. win-cell-crown-glow is the exception at 9.85-19.19 with a max of 255, and its side spikes reach well down the cell at 120x100. It is the least symbol-safe of the four.

The feature-spark-burst DOES have a real, occupied slot: `.entry-shockwave` at FreeSpinsPresentation.svelte:516, a 260x260 box scaling 0.2 -> 2.2 (peak draw 572px), currently loading ui/particles/shock_ring.png. Measured at the 572px peak draw: the candidate is SHARPER (edge sharpness 17.403 against the owner's WIP 13.149, a 32% gain, which is the real payoff of 256px source into a 4.5x upscale) but 33% DIMMER (energy 25.35 against 37.58). The other four accents genuinely have no consumer: the retrigger moment is a text div, spinsRemaining is a number, and the entry sequence has no horizontal band element.
